name: Orchestration
description: Developer, plus auto memory off, a hub repository for issues and owner questions and a memory repository; in each project the machine-local hub line and the Orca worktree setup.

settings.auto-memory.title: Auto memory off
settings.auto-memory.description: Claude Code neither writes nor reads its own notes from your sessions, so each session works only from the rules and files you can review; what should last goes into those rules or the project's docs (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory#auto-memory). Switched off after an apply, its keys stay in your Claude Code settings.json until you remove them.

hub.title: Hub repository: issues, triage labels and owner questions

wontfix.description: This will not be worked on

question.description: Owner decision needed: tick an option or comment, then set ready-for-agent

deferred.description: Owner deferred: the question queue skips it until the label is removed

local-manual.title: Machine-local line: where issues and owner questions go
